timely.label: Weather
timely.line: Today's Lebanon forecast: mostly sunny, a high near 75, a low around 54. Late October is showing off again.

timely.label: Weather
timely.line: Tomorrow's Lebanon forecast: mostly cloudy, a high near 74, a low around 56. Still shorts weather, technically.

timely.label: Gas Prices
timely.line: Missouri's average for regular gas is $3.92 today, down 26 cents from a month ago and up $1.23 from a year ago, according to Triple A, and Springfield averages $3.96. Your wallet will happily take the 26 cents.

timely.label: Hunting Season
timely.line: Fall firearms turkey season ends Saturday, October 31, in 5 days. The turkeys have Halloween circled too.

timely.label: Hunting Season
timely.line: Archery deer season ends Friday, November 13, in 18 days. Bowhunters, the clock is ticking.

timely.label: Hunting Season
timely.line: The November portion of firearms deer season opens Saturday, November 14, in 19 days, and runs through November 24. Time to dig out the orange hat.

timely.label: Hunting Season
timely.line: Archery deer season opens Wednesday, November 25, in 30 days, and runs through January 15. The bows get a second shift.

timely.label: Hunting Season
timely.line: Youth firearms deer season opens Friday, November 27, in 32 days, and runs through November 29. Leftover turkey sandwiches in the deer stand.

timely.label: Hunting Season
timely.line: Dove season ends Sunday, November 29, in 34 days. Last call for the dove crowd.

timely.label: Halloween
timely.line: Halloween is Saturday, October 31, in 5 days. Costume panic officially starts now.

timely.label: Clocks Fall Back
timely.line: Daylight saving time ends Sunday, November 1, in 6 days, so clocks fall back one hour and sunset comes an hour earlier. The oven clock will be wrong until spring.

timely.label: Veterans Day
timely.line: Veterans Day is Wednesday, November 11, in 16 days. A good week to thank someone who served.

timely.label: Thanksgiving
timely.line: Thanksgiving is Thursday, November 26, in 31 days. Start stretching now.

timely.label: 70 Years Ago
timely.line: Elvis Presley made his second appearance on The Ed Sullivan Show on this day in 1956, singing 'Hound Dog' and 'Love Me Tender' to an audience share over 80 percent. Networks still dream about numbers like that.

timely.label: Country Classic
timely.line: 'Islands in the Stream' by Kenny Rogers and Dolly Parton hit No. 1 on the U.S. singles chart on this day in 1983. Go ahead, try not to sing it.

timely.label: On This Day
timely.line: LeBron James made his NBA debut on this day in 2003 with 25 points, nine assists and six rebounds, even in a loss. Not a bad first day at work.

timely.label: TV Return
timely.line: NBC's hospital comedy 'St. Denis Medical,' starring Wendi McLendon-Covey and David Alan Grier, returns for season three Monday, Nov. 2. Finally, a hospital visit nobody dreads.

timely.label: Family Movie
timely.line: 'The Cat in the Hat,' an animated movie based on the 1957 Dr. Seuss book with Bill Hader voicing the Cat, opens in theaters Friday, Nov. 6. Green eggs sold separately.

johnsons.label: Outdoors
johnsons.line: Young Missouri hunters harvested 11,878 deer during the early youth portion of firearms deer season, with Howell, Franklin and Texas counties leading, the Missouri Department of Conservation reported. The next generation is doing just fine.

johnsons.label: Outdoors
johnsons.line: New research shows some whitetail bucks keep two separate home ranges, often miles apart, which is why a familiar buck can vanish from your hunting spot. He wasn't ghosting you, he was commuting.

johnsons.label: Outdoors
johnsons.line: Outdoor Life named New York, Pittsburgh, Miami and Milwaukee the four best big cities for fishing, thanks to cleaner waterways holding stripers, catfish and trout. The Ozarks would like a recount.

johnsons.label: Cooking
johnsons.line: Budget Bytes' chicken and broccoli skillet lasagna makes six hearty servings in 50 minutes, all in one pan. Fewer dishes, happier sink.

johnsons.label: Cooking
johnsons.line: Budget Bytes rounded up 13 easy sheet pan dinners for busy weeknights, from chicken and roasted veggies to pizza and tacos, all with less cleanup. The sheet pan is the hardest worker in the kitchen.

johnsons.label: Cooking
johnsons.line: A company called Wasted makes store-bought pasta out of leftover bread that would otherwise get thrown out, and a writer at The Kitchn calls it the most delicious store-bought pasta ever. Carbs, recycled into carbs.

johnsons.label: Cooking
johnsons.line: A Reddit poster meal-prepped a whole week of lunches for two: steak salads with spring mix, corn, mushrooms and New York strip, plus a pot of avgolemono, a Greek lemon soup. Meanwhile, our lunch plan is the drive-through.

johnsons.label: Life
johnsons.line: Signing up for student loan auto pay before Dec. 31 could cut the interest rate by 1 percent through June 2028, if the borrower meets every eligibility rule, according to Money Talks News. Savings for clicking one button.

johnsons.label: Life
johnsons.line: Over 68,000 Lexus NX vehicles from 2022 to 2024 are recalled, and owners can get a free software fix at the dealer, with letters expected by Dec. 7. A free fix is the best kind of fix.

johnsons.label: Life
johnsons.line: Amazon knocked $200 off the 65-inch Toshiba Z670R mini-LED TV, bringing it to $550. Football Sunday just got a bigger screen.

johnsons.label: Family
johnsons.line: A Reddit dad says trunk-or-treat is worse than door-to-door: his kids got stepped on by the family behind them, and they spent more time waiting in line than getting candy. Somewhere, a front porch feels vindicated.

johnsons.label: Family
johnsons.line: A Reddit parent says 10 is the best age so far, after a day of McDonald's, squishies from Five Below and frozen yogurt with their 10-year-old and her best friend. Old enough for fun, young enough to want you along.
